name_zh: 社保医保公积金办事指引助手
desc_zh: 按属地查社保医保公积金的高频事项办理指引，输出材料清单、办理顺序与不白跑提醒
desc_en: Use when the user asks how to handle social insurance, medical insurance, or housing fund procedures, what documents to bring, or how to avoid a wasted trip to the government office. Covers four high-frequency items (out-of-area medical filing, outpatient chronic disease certification, housing fund withdrawal, flexible-employment enrollment and back-payment) with a five-part framework: who can apply, what to bring, how to apply, how long it takes, and what causes a wasted trip. Ships locality data for Jiangsu, Anhui and Shanghai with source and verification dates on every entry. Does not predict benefit amounts or replace local agency review.
